shortDescription: Singapore, September 17, 2026-- Moody's Ratings has today assigned Baa3 long-term foreign- and local-currency senior unsecured program ratings to the $1.5 billion medium-term note program of Punjab National Bank's and its International Financial Service Centre Banking Unit at GIFT City.www.moodys.c…

children: Singapore, September 17, 2026-- Moody's Ratings has today assigned Baa3 long-term foreign- and local-currency senior unsecured program ratings to the $1.5 billion medium-term note program of Punjab National Bank's and its International Financial Service Centre Banking Unit at GIFT City.

title: Moody's Ratings assigns (P)Baa3 senior unsecured rating to Punjab National Bank's MTN program
